SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year LIKE 'FY%' AND fiscal_period = 3
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label
FROM dim_date

calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 3
ORDER BY fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date

SELECT AVG(fsw.closing_value) as average_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 3

SELECT COUNT(*) as record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.sku) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.store_key) as store_count
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 3

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_records, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_values,
       MIN(closing_value) as min_value,
       MAX(closing_value) as max_value,
       SUM(CASE WHEN closing_value < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as negative_values
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 3
